{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Identify and remove rows with sentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline
# We cannot use these values for analysis, so drop them
trial_df = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Verify the cleaning
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication and removing sentinel values: {trial_df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check the distribution of arms and severity again
print("\nDistribution of arms:")
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())
print("\nDistribution of severity:")
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Cross-tabulate arm vs severity to check for confounding
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']))"}
